subject: BrightLane trial: conversion allowance & short extension
messages:
From: Alex Liu <alex@brightlane.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask — trial runway for final POC

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at BrightLane is really excited about the latency and cost profile you showed for the small-entity extraction flows. We’re in the final stretch of our internal evaluation and one blocker is that our pilot token budget is going to run out before we finish the last set of end-to-end tests.

Would Redwood be open to a small one-off allowance or short trial extension to cover the last 2–3 workload runs so we can sign off and move to procurement? We’re targeting a decision by the end of December. If you can share the easiest path (credit vs extension and any conditions), I’ll brief procurement.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Alex Liu
Head of ML Platforms, BrightLane
alex@brightlane.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Liu <alex@brightlane.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — trial runway for final POC

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and glad the demo resonated.

We can usually accommodate a small conversion allowance to get customers over the finish line. To make sure we align internally, could you confirm:
- Target date you need the extension/allowance through (you mentioned end of December; do you need until Dec 31 or an earlier cutoff?)
- Approximate token/credit amount (or the set of tests you need covered) — a rough estimate is fine
- Any procurement/PO contacts we should loop in now so approvals don’t slow things down

Looping in Ben (sales) and Lauren (CS) to propose an operational path — Ben/LAuren, could we consider a one-time 25k-token allowance or a dollar credit equivalent and an automatic extension to 2026-12-15? If we need to go to EOM (12/31) I can route for a quick leadership sign-off.

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — trial runway for final POC

On Fri, Nov 20, 2026 at 11:03 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Looping in Ben (sales) and Lauren (CS) to propose an operational path — Ben/LAuren, could we consider a one-time 25k-token allowance or a dollar credit equivalent and an automatic extension to 2026-12-15?

Yes — we can do a small, conditional allowance. My recommendation:
- Offer: one-time "conversion allowance" equivalent to $3,000 (approx ~25k tokens for their expected run profile) OR a time-limited extension to 2026-12-20, whichever the buyer prefers
- Conditions: sign a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that commits to a POC acceptance criteria and a procurement kickoff (PO/intent) by 2027-01-15; one-time offer, not repeatable
- Reason: keeps levers tight but gives prospect runway to finish tests.

If the prospect agrees, I’ll draft the MAP and coordinate with Finance to flag the allowance against deal BRL-3021. Lauren — can you confirm the acceptance criteria language we typically use for these POCs so I can drop it into the MAP?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — trial runway for final POC

Ben/Jonas — I reviewed the ask. Approve with a conservative cap. Final sign-off:
- Approved allowance: $3,000 credit equivalent (document as "conversion allowance")
- Trial extension option: up to 2026-12-20 if customer prefers time vs credit
- Required: signed MAP (template attached) and procurement contact on cc or PO within 30 days of acceptance
- Escalation: any deviation (higher amount, longer date) needs Revenue Ops approval

Ben — please prepare the MAP and route the credit approval ticket with Finance (tag: BRL-3021-ALLOW). Jonas — you can communicate the offer to Alex.

V. Ortiz
VP, North America Sales Operations
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: Alex Liu <alex@brightlane.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightlane.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — trial runway for final POC

Thanks Jonas — that sounds fair and workable. BrightLane would like to accept the $3,000 conversion allowance and will take the time-based extension to 2026-12-20. Our procurement contact is procurement@brightlane.ai; I’ve attached the basic PO placeholder so your Finance team has something to reference.

Next steps from our side: procurement will process the PO and we’ll return a signed MAP once you send the template. Could you also confirm the expected timeline to apply the credit so we know when the extra runs will be unlocked?

Attached: PO-BrightLane-12345.pdf

Appreciate the quick turn — looking forward to closing this out.

—Alex
Alex Liu
Head of ML Platforms, BrightLane
alex@brightlane.ai
